title: Dotto: Ball Puzzle Logic Game
shortDescription: Guide the ball to the goal! Place arrows, shields & more in this logic puzzle.
fullDescription:
Think you can guide a ball to the goal? It sounds simple — until it isn't.

Dotto is a minimalist puzzle game that challenges you to think ahead. Place arrows, shields, teleporters, and other pieces on a grid to create the perfect path for the ball. Each world introduces a new mechanic, and the puzzles get deeper as you progress.

SIMPLE TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
Tap to place pieces on the grid, then watch the ball roll. Did it reach the goal? Great — move on to the next challenge. Did it crash into a destroyer? Time to rethink your strategy.

FRESH MECHANICS IN EVERY WORLD
Each world introduces something new to keep your brain working:
• Arrows — direct the ball along the right path
• Shields & Destroyers — protect the ball from obstacles
• Pauses & Movers — timing meets strategy
• Teleporters — warp the ball across the grid
• Rotating Arrows — pieces that change direction
• One-Shot Arrows — use them wisely, they disappear after one pass

WEEKLY CHALLENGES
A new hand-crafted puzzle every week. Complete it to earn rewards and build your streak. How many weeks in a row can you go?

ACHIEVEMENTS & LEADERBOARDS
Unlock achievements as you master each world. Connect with Google Play Games to track your progress and compete with friends.

CLOUD SAVE
Your progress syncs automatically across devices. Pick up right where you left off.

HINTS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
Stuck on a level? Use a free hint every 24 hours to reveal a piece placement. Earn bonus hints by completing weekly challenges.

DESIGNED TO RELAX
Clean, minimalist design with a soothing color palette. No timers, no pressure — just pure puzzle solving at your own pace.

Dotto is free to play with ads. Choose your ad preferences during setup.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle levels
• 7 unique worlds with distinct mechanics
• Weekly challenges with rewards
• Achievements and cloud save
• Free daily hint
• Clean, minimalist art style
• No internet required to play

Download Dotto and start solving today. Your brain will thank you.
